inventory.name: Lean 4.34.1 kernel
inventory.reason: type-checks every declaration and proof term, including the auxiliary lemma `decide +kernel` adds for each observation; the instance method `rfl` is a kernel definitional-equality check

inventory.name: kernel Nat literal evaluation (GMP)
inventory.reason: the declared observation and exhaustive method `decide +kernel` reduces the Decidable instance inside the kernel, which computes Nat.add, sub, mul, div, mod, gcd, beq, ble, land, lor, xor, shiftLeft, shiftRight, pow and log2 on literals with GMP instead of unfolding them; every word operation reduces to these. It refuses Nat.pow when the exponent does not fit in 32 bits (the D1-N09 message)

inventory.name: propext
inventory.reason: propositional extensionality, one of Lean's three standard axioms; used by simp and omega in the D1-TH proofs and inside proof fields of core definitions (the bound proofs of BitVec.xor, BitVec.not and BitVec.or, Vector index proofs, the structural-recursion encoding of group4), so it also appears in the audits of observations; propositions carry no computational content, so no evaluation depends on it

inventory.name: Quot.sound
inventory.reason: soundness of Lean's built-in quotients (it gives funext); used by simp and omega in the D1-TH proofs and inside the same core proof fields as propext; proof-only, never evaluated

inventory.name: core library Init and the built D006.Core (.olean files)
inventory.reason: imported without re-checking at lean's default trust level; BitVec, Vector, List and Nat definitions and lemmas come from the toolchain's Init, D006.Core is checked by the same kernel when the build compiles it

inventory.name: Lean 4.34.1 elaborator and tactics (simp, omega, decide, rfl)
inventory.reason: construct the proof terms; outside the trusted base because the kernel re-checks every term they produce. In DS-01 to DS-03 no native_decide and no compiler; DS-04's observations and its golden-certificate step use native_decide, declared with its own inventory entry in adapter.d/ds04.json
